en.description:
WatchOut is Breakout, rebuilt for your wrist. Turn the Digital Crown to slide the paddle, keep the ball alive, and clear 50 levels of increasingly devious brick layouts — no iPhone required, no touchscreen fumbling with your arm in the air.

WHY IT WORKS ON A WATCH

Most arcade ports fight the small screen. WatchOut is built around it: the Digital Crown gives you precise paddle control without your finger ever covering the action, and every level fits the display's rounded corners on purpose instead of by accident.

FEATURES

• 50 levels, 10 brick layouts (checkerboard, diamond, hourglass, pyramid, and more) cycling every 10 levels, so a layout only repeats right as difficulty jumps
• Ball speed and brick toughness ramp up as you climb — bricks starting at level 4 can take two hits, rendered a shade darker until the first one lands
• Catch falling power-ups: multi-ball splits your one ball into up to 12, and paddle-grow widens your paddle for 8 seconds (catch another mid-effect and the clock resets)
• Earn a bonus life on levels 10, 20, 30, and 40 — a heart power-up is guaranteed to drop early in the level, but you still have to catch it
• Catch every power-up that spawns in a level for a bonus-point bump on top of the points each one is already worth
• Persisted high score, so every run is chasing your own best
• 3 lives, and a randomized serve angle every time, so no two attempts play out the same

WatchOut is a standalone watch app. It runs entirely on your Apple Watch — open it from your wrist, no iPhone nearby needed.
en.releaseNotes:
WatchOut 1.1 brings a massive update packed with explosive gameplay, custom themes, full sound synthesis, and Game Center support!

WHAT'S NEW IN VERSION 1.1:

• EXPLOSIVE BOMB BRICKS: Starting at level 8, glowing bomb bricks appear! Destroy one to trigger a chain-reaction explosion that shatters surrounding bricks with fire particles and a deep boom.
• SAFETY FLOOR POWER-UP: Catch the new green capsule power-up to deploy a laser safety floor across the bottom of your screen for 8 seconds, bouncing falling balls back into play!
• COMBO MULTIPLIERS & SWEET SPOTS: Chain consecutive brick hits without touching the paddle to stack up to a 5x score multiplier (2x, 3x, 5x COMBO!). Hit the outer edges of your paddle for precision "SWEET SPOT!" boosts with spark bursts and tactile feedback.
• COLOR THEMES: Choose your vibe! Select between Cyber Neon, Synthwave, Matrix, and Classic Arcade themes from the main menu, complete with real-time background previews.
• SYNTHESIZED SOUND EFFECTS: 9 procedural arcade audio cues paired with Digital Crown haptics: paddle bounces, brick breaks, explosions, power-ups, fanfare, and extra lives, all synthesized right on your Apple Watch speaker.
• GAME CENTER LEADERBOARD & ACHIEVEMENTS: Compete on the global high-score leaderboard and unlock 7 distinct achievements (First Clear, Flawless Clear, Perfect Catch, Deep Run milestones, and Cumulative Score targets).
• TACTILE CROWN HAPTICS & MAIN MENU ACCESS: Enjoy subtle click feedback as you turn the Digital Crown, and return directly to the main menu at any time from pause, game over, or victory screens.
en.subtitle: Crown-Controlled Breakout
